domain.source: Existing H66 binary total-two shell of the twelve-port native carrier; H78 comparisons require explicit restriction maps. All C and E semantic outcomes remain.
domain.reference: The prepared three-charge diagonal reference and its record-derived full-shell extensions from PR1149; these are distinct from actual posterior corners and from the completion campaign stationary source/FIFO reference.
domain.native_operations: Existing complete C/E instruments, declared record-only seam selection, counted identity holds, finite FIFO and exported records. No hidden occupation read or new coherent correction.
domain.controller: At most 256 additional classical states in the retained native family. Reference-core metadata is counted and updated before record export; source-address metadata does not create a physical routing service.
domain.clock_services: The four existing PR1149 compiled words are supplied conditional services. Other reached cores must be reported as unavailable unless separately implemented and budgeted. No additional word or phase is silently admitted.
domain.wave_comparison: Reuse the existing native-return wave reference, finite-cap bounds and calibrated readout/field bridges on their declared domains. Test substitution of the PR1149 transported reference separately. Affine equality of clock and field generators is not required for a shared operational parameter.
domain.matter_target: Two occupied neighboring native ports form a finite adjacent-pair candidate. Define localization and exit independently of the update; report reference-exterior limitations, transport, lifetime and loss under complete branches.
domain.energy_target: Compare explicitly defined excess native activity with reference subtraction and the actual modular spectrum. A relativistic proper-time action is a conditional positive control. No physical mass is inferred from a relaxation rate, a count, or a definition m=E/c^2.
domain.parameters: Attempt count, actual native-event count and dimensionless modular/wave parameters must be named separately. SI c fixes a length/time ratio only after a common propagation dictionary.
domain.resources: Finite exact linear algebra, rational kernels and tractable compressed marginals. No cloud runs, empirical fits, discarded failures, or uncounted exported history.

acceptance.continuation: Account for reference metadata across FIFO export, preserve branch/reference maps, and identify the availability of the existing clock services.
acceptance.clock_wave: Construct a common operational map or give an exact scoped obstruction with an independent control. A mathematical Gibbs reference alone is not an executed service.
acceptance.localized: Compute exact native survival, motion and loss for the declared finite target with both laws and a feedback/exploration bound.
acceptance.energy: Test one common repair-energy relation against independently defined observables and kinetic-action constraints; classify missing mappings and failed ansatzes explicitly.
